find: Epicondylitis is inflammation of the epicondyle of the humerus (the bony projection at the elbow).
replace: Epicondylitis is a condition affecting the tendons at the epicondyle of the humerus (the bony projection at the elbow).
note: F2: Epicondylitis affects tendons at the epicondyle, not the bone itself.

find: X-rays detect whether bones are broken and whether a fracture is open or closed.
replace: X-rays show whether a bone is broken. An open fracture is identified by a wound that reaches the broken bone.
note: F3: Open status is determined by a wound reaching the fracture, not by the X-ray alone.

expect: A nebuliser converts medication into a fine mist for inhalation, used in severe asthma attacks when a standard inhaler cannot deliver sufficient medication.
value: A nebuliser turns medicine into a fine mist. It may be used in hospital for a severe asthma attack.
note: F4: Do not imply that a nebuliser is the next non-clinical step when an inhaler does not work.
